SELECT order_id, products_count, order_total, tax, shipping, email, created_at, updated_at, user_id, idempotency_key, status, source_cart_id, currency, stripe_session_id, paid_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, products_count, order_total, tax, shipping, email, user_id, idempotency_key, status, source_cart_id, currency, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productsCount}, #{orderTotal}, #{tax}, #{shipping}, #{email}, #{userId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{sourceCartId}, #{currency}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders o SET products_count = totals.products_count, tax = totals.tax, order_total = totals.subtotal + o.shipping + totals.tax, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT order_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::int4 AS products_count, COALESCE(SUM(line_total), 0)::int4 AS subtotal, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(line_total), 0) * 0.1)::int4 AS tax FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY order_id ) totals WHERE o.order_id = totals.order_id AND o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: INSERT INTO orders (products_count, order_total, tax, shipping, email, user_id, cart_id, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{productsCount}, #{orderTotal}, #{tax}, #{shipping}, #{email}, #{userId}, #{cartId}, #{key}) RETURNING *;

WITH existing_by_key AS ( SELECT * FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{key} ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO orders ( products_count, order_total, tax, shipping, email, user_id, cart_id, idempotency_key ) SELECT #{productsCount}, #{orderTotal}, #{tax}, #{shipping}, #{email}, #{userId}, #{cartId}, #{key} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_key) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING * ), existing_pending AS ( SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_key) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) ) SELECT * FROM existing_by_key
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM existing_pending
LIMIT 1
